exclude-rules.reason: These files declare error codes: the shared ones in errs, and each package's own in its errors.go. Every constant is a public API error code such as "oidc.refresh_token_invalid"; G101 matches words like token, secret and cred in their names. No credentials live in them.

The development seed refuses to run outside SERVICE_ENV=dev. Its credentials are fictional demo fixtures it prints for testers (G101); it uses a fixed-seed math/rand generator on purpose, so every run produces the same demo data (G404); and its int conversions are on small values it chose itself (G115).
